name: Dutch-American Friendship Treaty (DAFT) residence permit

requirements.blocker_text: This route is available only to US citizens, under the Dutch-American Friendship Treaty.
This requires a minimum investment of €4,500 in equity, maintained in the Dutch business for the duration of the permit.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and invest the required capital.

value.note: at least 25% ownership of the business

requirements.blocker_text: This requires owning at least 25% of the business.

evidence_required.document: KVK (Dutch Chamber of Commerce) business registration
Proof of €4,500 capital investment in the business

outcome.duration_length: 2 years initially, extendable up to 5 years

notes: The lowest capital bar and simplest process of any business/investment route encoded in this dataset so far across all three countries — no RVO points test, no business plan assessment, no minimum salary or profit threshold, just the €4,500 investment and 25% ownership. Since 1 April 2024, IND runs a faster pilot workflow: approval WITHOUT upfront proof of KVK registration and capital, checked retroactively around 6 months post-approval — a genuinely distinctive process worth surfacing, since it changes the practical order of operations compared to every other route in this dataset (apply first, prove compliance later, rather than prove-then-apply). No MVV/civic-integration-exam-abroad requirement for US nationals specifically on this route. A parallel Dutch-Japanese Trade Treaty gives similar rights to Japanese nationals but through nl_self_employed's treaty_exempt group rather than a dedicated route file, since the Japan case doesn't have DAFT's distinctive simplified/deferred-verification process.
